normalization: Originals as fetched under original/: the First1KGreek TEI from raw.githubusercontent.com pinned to commit ed91552c52530c8f5a3ddf2dd767e899372a804c, and Internet Archive scans with their OCR layers. text/<slug>.txt is the TEI reduced to plain text by seat.py (book and section headings kept); text/<slug>.ocr.txt is the Archive's OCR with line endings normalized. No text was corrected by hand.
scope: Ptolemy's Syntaxis (the Almagest) in Heiberg's Greek, held three ways: the First1KGreek TEI of the whole thirteen books, and the two Teubner volumes of 1898 (books I–VI) and 1903 (books VII–XIII) as scans with OCR. Archimedes in Heiberg's first edition, all three volumes (1880–81): the treatises in volumes I and II, Eutocius' commentaries in volume III, each with Heiberg's Latin. The Archive's OCR reads the Greek with errors; the loci are chosen where it reads true. Euclid is already seated (data/corpora/euclid, EA-CORPORA-20/04) and is not reseated. The First1KGreek Archimedes (tlg0552) is Mugler's Budé text of 1970–72, in copyright, and is not seated; PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit holds no Archimedes at the commit read (a6eb0cc3e6f6e382934a2c8b33577d2fb4371e00). Heiberg's second edition (1910–15) holds the Method, found in the palimpsest in 1906; its volume III (1915) is on the Archive (archimedisoperao0000jlhe) with no Greek in its OCR, and volumes I (1910) and II (1913) were not found there, so the Method is not held.

why_seated: Archimedes and Ptolemy are the two Greek authors whose demonstrations the Arabic and Latin traditions carried longest: the Sphere and Cylinder and the Sand-Reckoner on one side, the Syntaxis on the other, which the Arabs called al-Majisṭī. Heiberg edited both, and his Greek stands here beside his Euclid, already on the shelf. Thābit's Arabic Almagest stands in the Arabic seat of this seating.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-30: “and then an ea-corpora seating... Einstein, Gödel, Tesla, Copernicus, Galileo, classical Arabic mathematicians... what is in the public domain, and what else? and just to be perverse lets seat the promised Klee notebooks with them”; to the proposed set: “yes, thats a good set”.
